policy: Official Pokémon designs override fan/community interpretations. Existing archive sprites are accepted only when they clearly match the official form.

entries.official_reference: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension official Mega Garchomp Z reveal
entries.reason: The archived Z candidate has a pale/white front and a dark mismatched back and does not accurately represent the official airborne navy/orange, huge-winged design.

entries.official_reference: Pokémon.com Pokédex lists Mega Absol Z as Dark/Ghost
entries.reason: Available archive Z candidates are inconsistent front/back fan interpretations; use the official Mega Absol Z design as the visual source of truth.

entries.official_reference: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension official DLC materials
entries.reason: Neither archive candidate accurately matches the official Mega Baxcalibur silhouette, palette, and enlarged crystalline dorsal blade.
No verified official Mega Magmortar source was found in the current canon audit and the current Mega front/back set is stylistically mismatched.
No verified official Mega Milotic source was found in the current canon audit. The ER option is the stronger concept base but still needs a coherent matched DS front/back redraw.

next_action: Create/locate faithful DS-style conversions for official Mega Garchomp Z, Mega Absol Z, and Mega Baxcalibur before any further fan-sprite polishing. Keep Magmortar and Milotic in the custom redraw queue.
